stops.stop: London, The New Review: the machine that goes along time

The chronology lens placed the book at Woking, which the dates rule out: Wells did not move to Woking until May 1895. The correction is why this stop sits in London and not on Maybury Road.

stops.segment: Hanover Terrace and the End of the Tether
stops.stop: Old Harry Rocks, the ashes on the water
stops.date_confidence: year attested, month a placeholder. The afterlife lens tagged the scattering [R] and doubted the location; Wikipedia, 'Old Harry Rocks' states plainly that Wells's ashes were scattered in the water off Old Harry Rocks and cites Anthony West, H. G. Wells: Aspects of a Life (Hutchinson, 1984), p. 153, so the claim is retagged attested here. Anthony West was Wells's son by Rebecca West, not his son-in-law as the geography lens had it. The lens coordinate 50.6478, -1.9163 is replaced with Wikipedia's 50.6423, -1.9236.
stops.sun_caveat: year precision: the Sun could be in any sign; the reading above is for the stated (defaulted or conventional) day and should not be trusted
stops.moon_and_planets: omitted: the Moon changes sign every ~2.3 days; only day-precise stops get them
